input.quote: B. User Manuals. The reports made available to Customer shall be in substantial conformity with the customer bulletins and the User Manuals, as amended from time to time, copies of which have been, or will be, provided to Customer.
input.rationale: M&I gives express warranties in § 16.1 that its systems are capable of performing the Services per the Agreement (p0231), that reports will conform in substantial conformity with the User Manuals/bulletins (p0232), that it has the rights to provide the Services (p0233) and Millennium compliance (p0235). These warranties are not time-limited — they run for the whole term, which exceeds both the preferred 12-month/90-day and the fallback 90-day/30-day periods. Performance is backed by a service standard in § 9.1 (Performance Standards, otherwise commercially reasonable manner) and by regulatory compliance obligations in § 19.A, satisfying the compliance-with-laws element. Real remedies exist: service level credits (§ 9.2.D), a cure-or-default right with termination and damages (§§ 12.1(ii)-(iii), 12.3), and direct damages expressly including the cost of correcting errors in software maintenance and enhancements, implementing work-arounds and procuring the Services from an alternate source (§ 13.1.A-F). The all-caps disclaimer (p0236) is prefaced "EXCEPT AS SPECIFICALLY SET FORTH IN THIS SECTION 16.1", so it does not swallow the express warranties and is nowhere near the "AS IS" walk-away. Sub-elements short of the preferred wording — no express "professional and workmanlike" formulation (§ 9.1 instead says commercially reasonable "with no other or higher degree of care"), no malicious-code warranty, no dedicated repair/replace/refund remedy sentence, and documentation that M&I may amend "from time to time" — are noted but are not material failures given the unlimited warranty duration and the damages/credit remedies already in place. No redline proposed.
